summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Added EndpointResolverBuiltins (str, enum.Enum) at the end of botocore/regions.py with the eleven members and values from the spec. In botocore/args.py, added compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults to ClientArgsCreator (after _ensure_boolean), imported the enum as EPRBuiltins between the endpoint and signers imports, and made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept an absent endpoint_config (treated as no variant tags). Added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins to tests/unit/test_args.py with one test per behavioral criterion, including exactly one custom-data and one bundled-data SDK endpoint test. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 59 passed (37 existing); test_regions, test_client, test_utils 635 passed. Not run: black, isort, flake8 (not installed in the shared venv; not installed by me); line lengths checked with awk, all added lines within 79 columns. Pre-existing 82-column line at args.py:315 left untouched. Nothing committed. The regions.py on-disk change reported mid-session matched my appended content.
